title: Quantifying the Impact of Impact Investing
eligible_reason: Mainly a theoretical/calibration paper on impact investing. The only DiD (Table 2) is a single-date 2x2 comparison of annualized CAPM alphas of 11 Sematech member firms versus nonmember semiconductor firms before and after Sematech's formation (IsSematechPeriod = 1 from Sep 1987 for all firms), computed from per-stock CAPM regressions and bootstrapped group means. Not staggered and not a TWFE regression.
design_notes: ImpactInvestingCode.ipynb section 4.3: per-stock sm.OLS(trt1m_winsorized ~ const + vwretd) by tic x member x period, then mean alpha by 2x2 cell with bootstrap CIs. Monthly CRSP/Compustat data 1975-1999.
software_notes: Python (pandas, statsmodels) in a Jupyter notebook
screener_notes: Published PDF text checked (Table 2: 10.22% DiD lift). OpenAlex abstract empty.
